title: The worker request must suit every provider it can route
goal: Kimi rejects any temperature except 1 (HTTP 400 on turn 1) and the worker hard-codes temperature 0.0; Gemini 3.x spends the whole 4096-token budget on thinking for a complex prompt and returns an empty message. Drop the fixed temperature, raise max_tokens to the gateway cap, and have the gateway ask the gemini provider for low reasoning effort when the caller did not choose one.
